columns.comment: Month of the event date as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Jun-Sep 2026 = Month between DATE'2026-06-01' and DATE'2026-09-01'.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the liquidity event, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Predicted Shortfall (forecast net outflow - a funding need) or Predicted Surplus (excess cash - a deposit / investment opportunity).
columns.name: Event Type

columns.comment: Horizon of the forecast that flagged the event (30D = one month ahead).
columns.name: Horizon

columns.comment: RCF Drawdown (the client drew its revolving credit facility), TD Placed (a time deposit was placed) or None.
columns.name: Action Taken

columns.comment: Actioned, Open (still inside the 30-day action window at 30-Sep-2026) or Closed - No Action.
columns.name: Event Status

columns.comment: Forecast model that flagged the event (v1 or v2).
columns.name: Model Version

columns.comment: True for shortfalls followed by an RCF drawdown within 10 days (dim_threshold RCF_FOLLOW_UP_DAYS), linked in the loan schedule.
columns.name: Is RCF Drawdown Within 10D

columns.comment: True for predicted surpluses above USD 20m (dim_threshold SURPLUS_ATTENTION_USD).
columns.name: Is Large Surplus

columns.comment: True for predicted surpluses where no time deposit was placed - a deposit / investment opportunity.
columns.name: Is Surplus Not Placed

columns.comment: True when the client has a committed revolving credit facility.
columns.name: Has RCF

columns.comment: Liquidity-need events in the selection (a flow by event month).
columns.name: Events

columns.comment: Predicted shortfall events.
columns.name: Shortfall Events

columns.comment: Predicted surplus events.
columns.name: Surplus Events

columns.comment: Size of the predicted shortfalls / surpluses, USD (absolute value of the predicted net cash flow).
columns.name: Predicted Amount USD

columns.comment: Events followed by an action (RCF drawdown or TD placement).
columns.name: Actioned Events

columns.comment: Share of events followed by an action (fraction).
columns.name: Actioned %

columns.comment: Average days from the event to the RCF drawdown / TD placement, over actioned events.
columns.name: Average Days to Action

columns.comment: RCF amount drawn or TD amount placed after the events, USD.
columns.name: Action Amount USD

columns.comment: Estimated annual revenue of the actions (RCF margin or TD spread on the amount), USD.
columns.name: Revenue from Actions USD

columns.comment: Predicted shortfalls followed by an RCF drawdown within 10 days (storyline 9 - 15 of the 23 shortfalls in Jun-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Shortfalls Covered by RCF Within 10D

columns.comment: Predicted surpluses above USD 20m where no time deposit was placed - deposit opportunities.
columns.name: Large Surpluses Not Placed

columns.comment: Average undrawn RCF headroom of the clients with an RCF at the time of their events, USD.
columns.name: Average Undrawn RCF USD

comment: Liquidity-need events flagged by the cash-flow forecasts, Jul-2024 to Sep-2026: predicted shortfalls (forecast inflows below the expected outflows) and predicted surpluses, their predicted amount (USD), the action that followed - RCF drawdown (linked to the loan schedule), time deposit placed or none - the share actioned, days to action, the amount drawn / placed and the estimated annual revenue of the actions; plus the shortfalls covered by an RCF drawdown within 10 days and the large surpluses (> USD 20m) not yet placed. Counts and amounts add up over events and months; the client's primary RM (client block) is the RM of the event. Grain: one row per liquidity-need event (gold.fact_liquidity_need_event).
